# Mahbub College Students Association (MCSA)

> Official website of the Mahbub College Students Association, the alumni and former students' community of Mahbub College (also spelled Mahboob College), Secunderabad, Hyderabad, Telangana, India. The college was established in 1862.

Website: https://mahbubcollege.com
Phone: +91 8008576667
Email: support@mahbubcollege.com
Address: Mahbub College Campus, Secunderabad, Telangana, India - 500003

## About
- Mahbub College (Mahboob College) is a historic educational institution in Secunderabad, founded in 1862 by P. Somasundaram Mudaliar with the patronage of Asaf Jah VI, Mir Mahbub Ali Khan.
- It is remembered as the venue of Swami Vivekananda's 1893 lecture in Hyderabad.
- Institutions under the Mahbub College name include Anglo Vernacular High School, Mahbub Junior College, Mahbub Degree College and Mahbub PG College.
- The Students Association connects alumni and former students, issues membership IDs and membership cards, and organises reunions and events.

## Membership
Former students can register on the home page (section "Reconnect. Relive. Support & Save."). Registration requires a mobile number verified by OTP and the batch (year of leaving). Each member receives a unique Membership ID in the form "MAHBUB - <batch year> - <number>" and a downloadable membership card.
